summary: TWO-WEEK WINDOW (Aug 28 – Sep 11), and it splits cleanly in half. The first week was the best this account has had since early August: Stephski sent the Aug 15-31 invoice at 16:51 on Sep 1 — the promised day, no 'gathering your referrals' language, no error — and Sarah paid it ~18 hours later with 'Thanks guys🩷'; Olivia created an 'OFTV' topic on Aug 31 and got a catch-up call done on Sep 2; Mayson rolled out a content Drive; Vivek broke 22 days of silence. The second week gave almost all of it back. From Sep 4 to Sep 11, ALTR posted 11 messages and not one of them referenced a single open item. Olivia has not typed since 'content@of.tv' at 22:15 on Sep 2 — nine days, with the AI voice unfixed and the OFTV call never written up. Vivek has not typed since 17:41 on Sep 2, and his last words were 'Sarah hi ma'am send the password for suspended account' without ever saying which account, ten days unanswered. Ronnie has not typed in this chat since Aug 14 — 28 days. Derrek has not typed since 06:08 on Aug 25 — 17 days, and zero messages in this entire window. What DID happen in week two was Mayson opening two brand-new workstreams: a Sep 5 Google Meet about 'a brand new feature for posting trial reels on instagram', and a Snapchat handoff on Sep 9 ('We got a new team who works really good around snapchat posting and would love to take your account!') followed on Sep 10 by a second Drive and 'And add @mgmt_snap as admin'. Sarah said yes to every one of them within minutes. That is the shape of the whole fortnight: three new workstreams started (closeknit.ai autochat Aug 28, content Drive Aug 30, Snapchat Sep 9) and ZERO of the carried items closed. THE HEADLINE IS UNCHANGED AND NOW 33 DAYS OLD: her main Instagram @sarah.h44 (~530k) has not been named by a single human being — ALTR or Sarah — since 2026-08-09. Across 70 in-window messages the string does not appear once. The two backup accounts are 36 days down. Her earnings question is 34 days old with no plan and no owner. Derrek's Phone Farm updates are 41 days overdue. The Jul 18 leak links are 55 days old and the only answer she has ever received is 'their being worked on babes 💕'. And on Sep 9 Mayson asked her 'Hey Sarah do you have a snapchat and are you using it ?' — she gave ALTR that exact handle on 2026-02-04 and asked us to add it to her link. She paid in a single transfer for the second consecutive cycle, which confirms two consecutive invoices under her 50k AUD/day bank cap. Nobody has pulled the numbers; that request has now been open since Aug 28.

health.rationale: Down 6 from the 52 scored on 2026-09-04 (a score that was computed but never published because that run crashed). The first half of this window earned that 52 honestly — a clean invoice cycle, a senior non-billing conversation, engagement back to baseline, her warm register restored. The second half proves it was a spike, not a turn. Across Sep 4 – Sep 11 ALTR sent 11 messages, all from Mayson and Michelle, and none of them touched a single open item. The three people who owed her something — Olivia (AI voice, OFTV call write-up), Vivek (three down Instagram accounts), Ronnie (earnings plan, OFTV file) — went silent for 9, 9 and 28 days respectively. Derrek has now not posted in this chat since Aug 25, 17 days, and sent zero messages in a fourteen-day window for the second reporting period running. ZERO carried commitments closed in fourteen days. Every single one just aged: @sarah.h44 33 days, the two backup accounts 36, the earnings plan 34, the Phone Farm 41, the Jul 18 leak links 55, the 'mt cook hike' confirmation 28, credentials-out-of-group-chat 21. What holds this at 46 rather than the high 30s is genuinely good and worth protecting. The billing loop is now two cycles clean: invoice on the promised day, correct, paid inside 18 hours, receipt confirmed next morning ('You rock!'). Michelle Queue's leak breakdown posted for a sixth straight week (Aug 1, 10, 17, 25, Sep 1, Sep 8) and has still never lapsed. Engagement held — 28 client messages across the fortnight versus 3 in the week ending Aug 28 — and Mayson personally generated two calls and two new growth initiatives. And Sarah herself is maximally cooperative: 'Sure! What time works best for you', 'Yes I am!', 'Yes please!'. What that cooperation hides is the real risk. Of her 28 messages, exactly two were asks — 'Is my other 2 accounts back again?' (Aug 31) and 'How did you go with these ones?😊' (Sep 3) — and both got non-answers. Every other message she sent was her saying yes to something WE wanted. She has stopped asking us for the things she pays us for and started simply complying with whatever we bring her. On this account the absence of complaint has been the leading indicator since Aug 21, and it is now at its most complete: a client with a documented eleven-month bump habit, whose ~530k main account has been dead for 33 days, who has not mentioned it in three consecutive reporting windows. If the Sep 15 invoice is clean AND someone finally puts @sarah.h44 and an earnings plan in writing, this recovers to 60+. If Sep 15 is the next substantive thing she hears from us, this is a month-to-month 30% agreement heading for a quiet non-renewal.
